item.subject: science
item.stem: Priya keeps one variegated leaf of her potted money plant in sunlight for six hours, and keeps a similar leaf from the same plant fully covered in darkness. She then tests both leaves with iodine solution. In which parts will she detect starch?

options.A: Starch is detected only in the originally non-green patches of the sunlit leaf.
options.B: Starch is detected in the green patches of the sunlit leaf, but not in the non-green patches or in the leaf kept in the dark.
options.C: Starch is detected in both the green and non-green patches of the sunlit leaf.
options.D: Starch is detected in the leaf kept in the dark, but not in the sunlit leaf.
